argv: from pathlib import Path; import json; print("Model bytes:",sum(p.stat().st_size for p in Path("model").rglob("*") if p.is_file())); rows=[json.loads(s) for s in next(Path("cache/huggingface/xet/logs").glob("*.log")).read_text().splitlines()]; r=next(r for r in reversed(rows) if "observed bytes sent so far" in r.get("fields",{}).get("message","")); print(r["timestamp"],r["fields"]["message"])
